exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to sound, to ring out (usually unexpectedly), to go off (e.g. telephone, gunshot)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: рассказа́ть — to tell; разда́ться — to sound, to ring out (usually unexpectedly), to go off (e.g. telephone, gunshot); раскры́ть — to open; расста́ться — to part, to separate.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to wake up, to awake, to waken
to dismantle, to disassemble, to take apart, to deconstruct
to go away, to disperse (in different directions), to spread
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: расчёт — calculation (mathematical operation); разбуди́ть — to wake up, to awake, to waken; разобра́ть — to dismantle, to disassemble, to take apart, to deconstruct; разойти́сь — to go away, to disperse (in different directions), to spread.
**издал** — изда́ть (perfective): to publish, to print; to edit; to issue, to promulgate, to enact; to utter, to emit, to exhale. Wiktionary: из- + дать.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to break, to crash, to crush, to smash, to shatter
to burst out laughing, to start laughing
to tear apart/asunder, to tear up
to go away, to disperse (in different directions), to spread
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: разби́ть — to break, to crash, to crush, to smash, to shatter; рассмея́ться — to burst out laughing, to start laughing; разорва́ть — to tear apart/asunder, to tear up; расходи́ться — to go away, to disperse (in different directions), to spread.
